description: Configure auto-eat options. Only the provided fields are changed. priority selects how food is ranked; minHunger/minHealth are the thresholds that trigger auto-eating; bannedFood lists item names to never eat.

eatingTimeout.description: Max ms to wait for an eat to complete

minHealth.description: Eat automatically when health is at or below this (0-20)

minHunger.description: Eat automatically when hunger is at or below this (0-20)

returnToLastItem.description: Re-equip the previously held item after eating

strictErrors.description: Throw on recoverable errors instead of swallowing them

name: autoeat_configure
